title: A Crown for the Sigil
author: Mara Halloran
blurb: Marguerite Voss, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
